exception.justification: Justified: This pre-installation selector emits only the selected direct terminal diagnostic and cannot instrument itself.

review.body: { if let Err (error) = observation :: select_process_policy () { if error != observation :: EmissionConfigurationError :: ConflictingInputs { let mut record = ControlPlaneRecord :: usage_error (command_name , "observation_configuration") ; record . message = error . to_string () ; let _ignored = emit_control_plane_record (& record) ; } exit_with (CommandExit :: Usage) ; } }
review.item_premise: This pre-installation policy helper reads public mode inputs or immutable kind state without a private carrier or independent delivery; its terminal diagnostic belongs to the shared command boundary.
